Trigger: Overwhelming stress from the Embrace combined with the psychological conditioning of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} Oath and the pull of the pyramid hierarchy.

Unable to cope with the moral weight of the Beast, feeding, and the sudden loss of humanity, a victim of this disorder transfers all personal responsibility onto the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} pyramid itself. What the hierarchy commands, the sufferer obeys without question; what the code prohibits, she fanatically shuns. Confronted with any choice outside those bounds, she can only offer a rote answer or an uncomfortable admission that she doesn't know what to think.

The character loses all capacity for independent moral judgment; every decision is filtered through "what does the pyramid say?" As with other derangements, a character may spend a Willpower point (System) or Willpower Trait (MET) to force a moment of independent clarity and act on her own judgment for a single scene, though the underlying disorder remains until treated through extended therapy or dramatic roleplaying resolution. Tremere superiors are quick to notice and often deliberately assign such drones to dangerous, clan-serving tasks, since a follower without initiative is only useful (or expendable) in narrow circumstances.

Also listed for Storytellers under Rules Reference (Storyteller Only): @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference-st.JournalEntry.9e49e2b00b8442e3]{Hierarchical Sociology Disorder} (same write-up, kept there too for topical browsing).
